scientific.integrity: The central energy identity was checked coefficient-by-coefficient using exact arithmetic. The endpoint uses a proper Lyapunov function and LaSalle invariance; no numerical trajectory is used as proof. Literature comparisons distinguish a known special Darboux curve from the broader half-space theorem.
scientific.limitations: The theorem certifies the closed half-space \(a\ge1/b\) but does not claim that this is the full global-stability region. It concerns bounded complete trajectories for the strict recurrence ceiling and compactly supported invariant measures for the uniqueness statement.

title: A closed global-stability half-space and a strict recurrence ceiling in the Huang–Li financial flow
